en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4.  The narrator says that he heard Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) say, “One who fasts on first of Shaban then surely, Paradise would be made obligatory for him. If he observes two fasts, the  Almighty  Allah would look  at him  with mercy  in this world  every  day  and  night.  He  would  also  shower  His mercy  on  him  in  Paradise.  One  who  fasts  for  three  days would  get  to  visit  Allah  daily  on  the  Divine  throne  in Paradise.”
